title: SDD phase result contract
description: Default structured output for run-agy-phase (Gentle-ai-mod v1.2). Prefer simple types; status is a free string for reliability.

status.description: Phase outcome, e.g. success | failed | partial

executive_summary.description: Short human-readable summary of what was done

artifacts.description: Artifact references (topic keys, paths, or observation ids as strings)

next_recommended.description: Next recommended SDD step or action

risks.description: Risks as strings or small objects

skill_resolution.description: How skills were resolved, e.g. paths-injected | fallback-path | none
